options.name: Soft classic
options.detail: Closest to the reference. Short tousled blue-black bob with softly flicked ends and side-swept bangs. Delicate round black glasses, muted rose-hazel eyes, subtle eyeliner, fair neutral skin and a small relaxed smile. Black fine-knit turtleneck with a slightly relaxed fit, dark charcoal-blue straight fitted jeans with realistic seams and wrinkles, a slim antique-gold chain with small cross pendant, simple chain bracelet, lace-up black leather ankle boots. Gentle cheeks and understated makeup. Natural everyday goth styling.

options.name: Cozy goth
options.detail: A softly rounded chin-length black bob, airy curtain fringe, small oval black glasses, gray-green eyes, fair skin with subtle warm blush and a quiet friendly expression. Soft black ribbed mock-neck sweater with comfortably loose sleeves, dark washed high-waisted straight jeans, a fine silver pendant and small hoop earrings, simple black chunky ankle boots. Clothing should drape naturally; fine knit and denim textures. A cozy, understated goth woman with softer shapes.

Opaque black high-neck blouse with delicate lace trim over solid fabric, a lightweight charcoal open cardigan, a practical black pleated midi skirt, opaque black tights and lace-up ankle boots. Small silver crescent pendant and rings. Modern restrained romantic goth, graceful natural silhouette and soft cloth folds, no costume excess.
